prompt: We are certified to ISO 27701:2019. What does transitioning to the 2025 edition actually require us to implement?
assertions: States there are no new controller/processor controls to implement; the work is re-mapping evidence to the new numbering and structure
Gives the transition deadlines: certification bodies by October 31, 2027 and certified organizations by October 31, 2028
Notes the 2025 edition is standalone certifiable (no ISO 27001 certificate prerequisite), with the shared A.3 block to account for
Does not instruct implementing 'new' retention, disposal or transmission controls
Advises updating the SoA/documentation mapping for the transition audit
